name: MyCater
description: B2B catering marketplace for French companies — breakfast, lunch, corporate events, cocktail receptions — with curated caterers, ordering, invoicing, and support for HR / EAs / office managers (company-stated). Founded Nov 2020, FR. Team 2–5, bootstrapped. ~1,000 estimated users; 5-star rated (founder-stated). Stack: TypeScript/JS, Cloudflare, MySQL, Node.js, RabbitMQ, Sentry, Stripe. Channels: newsletter, SEO. DR 39.

whyItPrints: Office catering is a weekly recurring ops headache. $0 seat MRR with ~$70.6k L30 (+98%) and ~$2.45M all-time means take-rate / order GMV through Stripe, not SaaS seats — classic marketplace boring. Same lane as MyTraiteur (covered Oct 7) but this is the buyer-side B2B marketplace, not a quote tool.
